sentences.cn_text: 一群工党议员,其中包括伊薇特·库珀,在新年之际呼吁设立英国「文化小镇」奖项。
sentences.en_text: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK “town of culture” award.

sentences.cn_text: 该提议是让这一奖项与现有的「文化之城」称号并列,后者曾于2017年由赫尔市获得,并已授予考文垂市用于2021年。
sentences.en_text: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.

sentences.cn_text: 库珀及其同事认为,赫尔市获此殊荣所取得的成功——带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和艺术活动的蓬勃发展——不应仅限于城市。
sentences.en_text: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.

sentences.cn_text: 英国的小镇确实并未被禁止申请,但它们通常缺乏资源来组织一份能够击败更大竞争对手的申请方案。
sentences.en_text: Britain’s towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.

sentences.cn_text: 据称,文化小镇奖可以成为年度活动,吸引资金并创造就业机会。
sentences.en_text: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.

sentences.cn_text: 有人可能将这一提议视为一种安慰奖,因为英国已无法再申请更具声望的欧洲文化之都头衔——这一备受追捧的奖项曾被格拉斯哥(1990年)和利物浦(2008年)摘得。
sentences.en_text: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a soughtafter award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.

sentences.cn_text: 悲观者可能会推测,英国正处于陷入无休止的自我庆祝狂热之中的边缘,急于在后脱欧时代重塑自我:继文化小镇之后,谁知道接下来会是什么——文化村庄?
sentences.en_text: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow — village of culture?

sentences.cn_text: 文化郊区?
sentences.en_text: Suburb of culture?

sentences.cn_text: 文化村落?
sentences.en_text: Hamlet of culture?

sentences.cn_text: 同样明智的是要记住,此类头衔并非万能良方。
sentences.en_text: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.

sentences.cn_text: 一个管理不善的「文化年」如潮水般涌入又退出一个地方,带来短暂的知名度,却未能为社区留下任何持久的益处。
sentences.en_text: A badly run “year of culture” washes in and out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.

sentences.cn_text: 真正成功获得此类头衔的,是那些所作所为远不止填满酒店客房、引入高端艺术活动以及赢得一年好评的地方。
sentences.en_text: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.

sentences.cn_text: 它们改变了当地居民的愿景;它们将城市的自我形象推向更加大胆和乐观的境地。
sentences.en_text: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.

sentences.cn_text: 这很难做到,需要非凡的远见,以及市政当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。
sentences.en_text: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.

sentences.cn_text: 但这是可以做到的:格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年,无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一,这些因素使该市成为至今仍然是艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇的动力源泉。
sentences.en_text: But it can be done: Glasgow’s year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.

sentences.cn_text: 「文化小镇」不仅可以关乎艺术,还可以关乎尊重小镇的独特性——帮助维持其商业街,支持当地设施,最重要的是赞颂其居民。
sentences.en_text: A “town of culture” could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town’s peculiarities — helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.

sentences.cn_text: 文化大臣杰里米·赖特应欢迎这一充满希望的积极提议,并将其付诸行动。
sentences.en_text: Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.

sentences.en_text: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a “town of culture” award could ____

sentences.cn_text: 巩固英国城镇与城市之间的联系。
sentences.en_text: consolidate the town-city ties in Britain.

sentences.cn_text: 促进英国城镇之间的合作。
sentences.en_text: promote cooperation among Britain’s towns.

sentences.cn_text: 增强英国城镇的经济实力。
sentences.en_text: increase the economic strength of Britain’s towns.

sentences.cn_text: 将英国有限的资源集中于文化活动。
sentences.en_text: focus Britain’s limited resources on cultural events.
